name: Mitten Extracts Disposable 2-In-1 Flip | Cotton Candy Kush + Grape Ape OG
description:
Sugary sweetness meets deep grape flavor in this dessert-inspired duo. Cotton candy notes deliver light, nostalgic sweetness while Grape Ape OG adds rich, juicy depth.

2 Grams. Two flavors. Three modes. Total control - Flavor for taste, Balance for smooth hits, Clouds for max output.
